validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: confirmed. FERC, Mountain Valley Pipeline, LLC, 171 FERC para 61,047, Docket CP19-477-000 (April 16, 2020) authorizes the Greene Interconnect Project; the Federal Register notice of Oct 7, 2021 records it as mechanically complete in late February 2021; EIA records it Complete with in-service date 2024-06-14. IDENTITY: P4456 is the MVP GREENE INTERCONNECT PROJECT - a new metering & regulating station plus a new tap on the MVP mainline in MONROE COUNTY, WEST VIRGINIA, with only 370 feet of new pipe (30 ft of 24-inch inlet H-606 and 340 ft of 30-inch outlet H-607), designed to deliver ~1.0 Bcf/d from the MVP mainline into Columbia Gas Transmission, LLC's KA System, estimated at USD 28,000,000, placed in service 14 June 2024 when the mainline started up. CLASSIFICATION: interstate transmission interconnect/station, correctly 'transmission' and correctly LengthKnown ~ 0. DUPLICATE CHECK vs P0220: NOT a duplicate. P0220 is the MVP MAINLINE - 303 miles, 42-inch, 2,000 MMcf/d, Wetzel County WV to Pittsylvania County VA, FERC Docket CP16-10, cost in the billions. Five sheet-level discriminators separate them: length 0 (370 ft) vs 303 mi; diameter 24/30 in vs 42 in; capacity 1,000 vs 2,000 MMcf/d; cost USD 28 million vs multi-billion; docket CP19-477 vs CP16-10. And the FERC order says so in terms (footnote 14): 'The Greene Interconnect Project is distinct from the approval of the mainline project.' The two rows share a PipelineName only. DUPLICATE CHECK vs P7829 ('MVP Interconnect Expansion', batch A5): also NOT a duplicate. EIA records that project as announced in 2025, USD 125 million, 350 MMcf/d, in service 2028 - a different, later scope. The batch prompt's working hypothesis that P4456 might be 'an interconnect at MVP's Greene County PA/WV end' is REFUTED: the asset is in Monroe County, West Virginia, and 'Greene' is the interconnect's own name, not a county reference. WIKI CITATIONS: the harvest carries 61 citations / 61 distinct URLs for this PID, but all 61 are harvested from the SHARED gem.wiki 'Mountain Valley Gas Pipeline (MVP)' page and every one of them concerns the mainline, the Southgate extension or mainline opposition - none names the Greene Interconnect, so none is usable as a ref for this row under rule 4(a). What IS established and bounds it: (a) FERC's April 16, 2020 order (171 FERC para 61,047, CP19-477) authorized the facilities but ordering paragraph (B) STAYED that authorization 'until Mountain Valley receives appropriate federal permits, and the Director of the Office of Energy Projects lifts the stop-work order' - so no construction before that; (b) the Federal Register notice of Oct 7, 2021 in CP19-477 states 'the Greene Interconnect facilities were mechanically complete and ready for service in late February 2021' - so construction finished by Feb 2021. summary: P4456 is the MVP GREENE INTERCONNECT PROJECT (FERC Docket CP19-477-000), not the MVP mainline: a metering & regulating station plus a new tap in Monroe County, West Virginia with 370 feet of new pipe (30 ft of 24-in inlet H-606, 340 ft of 30-in outlet H-607), delivering ~1.0 Bcf/d from the MVP mainline into Columbia Gas Transmission's KA System at a cost of USD 28,000,000, mechanically complete in late February 2021 and placed in service 14 June 2024 when the mainline started up. It is NOT a duplicate of P0220 (the 303-mile, 42-inch, 2,000 MMcf/d, CP16-10 mainline from Wetzel County WV to Pittsylvania County VA) - five sheet-level discriminators separate them and the FERC order says the two are distinct in terms; the shared PipelineName is a labelling defect, flagged in cross_row_leads, and nothing on P0220 was touched. All 16 worklist units are reported. Six units carried https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/data.php#pipelines, the navigation page the batch ADDENDUM rules out, and a seventh carried an operator landing page that does not name this segment; all seven were re-grounded on the FERC order, the two CP19-477 Federal Register notices, the Thompson Energy report and dated EIA release workbooks. No sheet value was contradicted: every populated cell (Status, Fuel, PipelineType, StartYear1, Delayed/DelayType, Capacity, LengthKnown, SegmentCost, Owner1, the two country cells) was confirmed as recorded. Nine blank or partly blank cells were filled and cited - ProposalYear/Month 2019-06, StartMonth1 6, Diameter '24, 30' in, FuelSource Marcellus/Utica (low tier, parent-system source, caveated), all six remaining Location cells, SegmentCostYear 2019 and Operator - and two units end UNRESOLVED with the search documented: Construction (no source states a start date; bounded to the window between the Oct 2020 partial lift of the stop-work order and mechanical completion in late February 2021) and Pressure (no MAOP in any reachable source; the FERC order is silent and EIA carries no such field). Access failures encountered and recorded as tooling problems rather than evidence: spglobal.com 403, cms.ferc.gov and ferc.gov/search 403 behind Cloudflare, the FERC eLibrary search API 404, SEC EDGAR full-text 0 hits for "Greene Interconnect", and archive.org returning 429/Temporarily Offline on every attempt.
